items.title: From AI coding assistants to AI teammates: is software engineering 3.0 already here?
items.description: Research Summary of two papers: the vision of AI-native software engineering 3.0, and AIDev, 456,535 pull requests opened by autonomous coding agents on GitHub.
items.author: Patrick Loic Foalem
items.bio: Founder and Principal Research Scientist at GAMA Institute. PhD candidate in software engineering at Polytechnique Montréal, specializing in machine learning systems engineering and AI software reliability.

contribute.body: Have you studied a paper and want to explain it simply? Send us your summary. The GAMA team reviews it with you before publication.
contribute.tpl_body: 5-part structure, 500 to 900 words, writing rules and tips for visuals: it is all in our publication guidelines.
